title: Electronics Return Policy
content: Enterprise Retail Demo policy marker ENT-REFUND-7D-2026. For electronics products returned for non-quality reasons, customers may request a return within 7 calendar days after delivery when packaging, accessories and serial labels are complete. Confirmed quality defects may be returned or exchanged within 30 calendar days.

title: Apparel Return Policy
content: Apparel products may be returned within 15 calendar days after delivery when unworn, unwashed and with original tags attached. Size-related returns follow the same 15-day window.

title: High Refund Rate Investigation SOP
content: If a category's rolling 7-day refund rate exceeds 15 percent, the operations owner must open a root-cause investigation within 1 business day and review product quality, fulfillment accuracy and listing expectations.

title: Autumn Member Week Rules
content: Autumn Member Week runs from 2026-09-15 through 2026-09-21. Gold members receive 10 percent off eligible campaign products. The campaign includes Aurora ANC Headphones, Linen Travel Shirt and Trail Running Shoes.

title: NorthStar Electronics SLA
content: NorthStar Electronics supplies Aurora ANC Headphones, Orbit Mechanical Keyboard and PixelDesk Lamp. Standard fulfillment SLA is 48 hours for in-stock purchase orders.

title: EastBridge Supply SLA
content: EastBridge Supply supplies Linen Travel Shirt and BrewPro Coffee Grinder. Standard fulfillment SLA is 72 hours.
